The presence of Cyp2b6 in the pathway, though not directly bound by Cinnarizine, suggests a possible functional relationship through shared metabolic processes. The integration of these pathways highlights a potential mechanism by which Cinnarizine may interact with Cyp2b6, though the exact nature of this interaction remains unclear. The evidence supports a functional link, but further investigation is needed to clarify the precise mechanism of action.
